summary: End-to-end certification of the vision-LLM extraction fix (Emergent universal key -> openai gpt-4o), AVIF support, /documents endpoints, and the new Docs view UI. ALL backend (12/12 pytest) and ALL frontend Playwright flows GREEN. The blank-PDF 422 regression from iteration_5 is FIXED. Personalausweis fields (MUSTERMANN, HANS, 14.03.1967, 10.12.2028) extracted via vision; Führerschein AVIF returns DRIVING LICENSE with categories array; S3 invoice JSON via real LLM; async upload polls PENDING -> COMPLETED with vision result; auth 401/403 enforced; /api/v1/documents lists 3 docs and renders PRD/TRD/APP_FLOW markdown with rendered headings/tables and zero raw '**' artifacts; nav-console <-> nav-docs switching works. mock=false and ocrEngine='vision:openai:gpt-4o' confirmed on the wire via curl AND the UI ocr-badge after a stable run.

minor.issue: result.transcription field is returned as empty string on vision path (UI markdown tab can fall back to Tesseract transcription in that case). Not a regression — UI still renders structured JSON correctly; just a polish item if a clean vision transcription is desired in the markdown view.

Observed one out of N invocations where the response carried ocrEngine='tesseract:deu+eng' instead of 'vision:openai:gpt-4o' (still mock=false, structured fields correct). Likely a non-deterministic fallback to Tesseract+LLM when the vision JSON is malformed. Reproducible at low rate; advise instrumenting which branch ran in the response for observability.

action_items: (optional/minor) Have vision_extract populate result.transcription with the model's transcription text so the Markdown tab on vision-extracted images shows a clean transcription instead of falling back to noisy Tesseract output.
(optional/minor) Add a per-response field (e.g. extractionPath: 'vision' | 'tesseract+llm' | 'mock') for ops/observability so the rare Tesseract fallback case can be tracked.
critical_code_review_comments: ExtractionResult shape now correctly carries ocrEngine='vision:openai:gpt-4o' and model='openai:gpt-4o' separately — good. Consider adding 'extractionPath' as above for observability.
OCR_VISION=true is honoured. AVIF round-trip in ocr_service.image_to_b64 works end-to-end (verified via /app/tests/fixtures/fuehrerschein.avif).
Blank/corrupt PDF path now returns 422 problem+json (the iter5 PDFium regression is closed).
DocsPanel.jsx + Markdown.jsx render headings and tables correctly with no leftover '**' bold artifacts; nav switching between Console and Docs preserves state.

Frontend useDocIntel.js POSTs to ${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/v1/extract/* and auto-mints the demo token — good; one-time 'Failed to fetch' line in console at startup appears to be pre-token-mint health probe that recovers immediately (no UX impact).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All review_request bullets are GREEN. The vision LLM path (gpt-4o via Emergent universal key) is verified end-to-end on both German ID samples and the AVIF driving licence. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_vision_and_docs.py is the authoritative regression suite for this fix — re-run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) python -m pytest backend/tests/test_vision_and_docs.py -v . The legacy /app/backend/tests/test_extraction_api.py and test_regression_formats.py assert MOCK-mode invariants and are NOT compatible with the current real-LLM config — do not treat their failures as bugs. One minor non-determinism observed: ~1 in N image extractions returns ocrEngine='tesseract:deu+eng' instead of 'vision:openai:gpt-4o' (LLM fallback path); the structured payload remained correct in those cases.
rca of the issue: Original user-reported bug ('German ID images not being extracted') is RESOLVED. Verified via curl + Playwright + pytest: backend returns mock=false, ocrEngine='vision:openai:gpt-4o', structured = {documentType:'Personalausweis', surname:'MUSTERMANN', givenNames:'HANS', dateOfBirth:'14.03.1967', dateOfExpiry:'10.12.2028', placeOfBirth:'MUSTERSTADT', country:'Deutschland', ...}. AVIF (fuehrerschein.avif) is re-encoded and processed through the same vision path, returning documentType='DRIVING LICENSE' with a categories array. Blank-PDF 422 regression from iter5 is also closed.
